newsitem.title: UK: Odds cut on UK Conservatives' election win.
newsitem.headline: Odds cut on UK Conservatives' election win.

text.p: The odds on the British Conservatives retaining power at the election were cut to 6-4 from 7-4 following the annual budget on Tuesday, Ladbrokes bookmakers said on Wednesday.
"Within an hour of the budget, we were overwhelmed by enquiries from our customers wanting to back the Tories (Conservatives)," a statement from Ladbrokes said.
The odds on the opposition Labour party, well ahead in opinion polls, went out to 2-5 from 4-11. The centrist Liberal Democrats remain at 300-1. The election must be held by May 22.
